# Fresh Number Checker (India)

> The industry standard, zero-OTP mobile number freshness and recycle-status verification platform for Indian telecom networks (+91).

Fresh Number Checker is an automated enterprise-grade intelligence platform accessible via Telegram (`@freshnumcheckerbot`) and Web. It allows businesses, digital marketers, fintech lenders, and telecom distributors to instantly verify whether an Indian 10-digit mobile number is a brand-new pristine allocation or a recycled/reassigned MSISDN previously owned by another subscriber.

## Core Capabilities
- **Zero-OTP Passive Verification**: Queries authoritative telecom clearinghouses and public merchant directories passively. Does not send disruptive SMS OTPs, trigger phone rings, or alert the subscriber.
- **Telecom Circle & Carrier Coverage**: Full nationwide support across all 22 Department of Telecommunications (DoT) circles in India. Supports Reliance Jio, Bharti Airtel, Vodafone Idea (Vi), and BSNL/MTNL.
- **Sub-Second Latency**: Ephemeral in-memory asynchronous verification engine delivering results in 800ms - 2,500ms.
- **Privacy First (DPDP Act 2023 Compliant)**: 100% ephemeral memory processing. Zero permanent storage of scanned phone numbers, contact books, or subscriber personal data.
- **Bulk Batch Processing**: Verify hundreds of numbers simultaneously via `.txt`, `.csv`, or in-chat newline delimiters.

## Key Use Cases
1. **Fintech & Loan Underwriting**: Prevent loan fraud and identity theft caused by lending to recycled numbers with degraded credit histories.
2. **E-Commerce & COD Verification**: Reduce Return to Origin (RTO) rates by detecting discarded or volatile numbers before shipping cash-on-delivery orders.
3. **Telemarketing & CRM Cleansing**: Cleanse customer databases in compliance with TRAI TCCCPR 2018 regulations to eliminate DND complaints.
4. **SIM Allocation Quality Control**: Help telecom retailers and consumers verify that new SIM purchases are completely fresh and unlinked from prior debt collectors or spam lists.

## Bot Usage Commands
- `/start`: Initialize secure session and access quick-action interactive dashboard.
- `/fresh`: Run instant freshness and recycling check on any 10-digit Indian phone number.
- `/help`: Contact 24/7 priority compliance and technical support desk.
